title: `FeeTierPoints` is incorrectly increased twice
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The execution of the position size increase will call `TradingCommonUtils.updateFeeTierPoints()` to update the trader fee tier points by the position size delta.  However, the trader fee tier points have been updated in the preceding call `TradingCommonUtils.processOpeningFees()`.  That means the trader fee tier points are incorrectly updated twice, causing the trader to receive double the points.
